data.title: 艾尔菲利亚 · 冰之魔法的茶会
data.description: 塔中庭，她用冰魔法冻住茶杯外壁做冰镇茶，又细心地在杯垫上凝出小花形状的霜；一个人也要讲究的下午茶，是深居生活的仪式感。

data.promptProse: Elfaria Alvis Serfort carefully chills her tea by freezing the cup's outer wall, then forms small frost flowers on the coaster with one fingertip. Her opaque white long dress and light-blue cardigan keep the afternoon ritual relaxed. The medium portrait includes the courtyard table and tower walls around it. Afternoon daylight glints through the new ice and reveals flower-shaped frost edges, with a cooler reflection on her hand and a soft cup shadow below.
